title: Resident Evil 4 - Interactive Attache Case Inventory
description:
[h1]▲ FOR THE FULL EXPERIENCE (KEYBOARD CONTROLS) ▲[/h1]
Due to security restrictions, keyboard input is blocked natively for web wallpapers. To enable full keyboard shortcuts (like rotating items with your keyboard):
[list=1]
[*]Open Wallpaper Engine, click [b]"Open Wallpaper"[/b] at the bottom left, and choose [b]"Open from URL"[/b].
[*]Paste this link into the field and click OK: [url=https://sem-py.github.io/re4-inventory/]https://sem-py.github.io/re4-inventory/[/url]
[*]On your desktop, press [b]ALT + K[/b] (or your assigned hotkey) to hide desktop icons and enable keyboard input.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[url=https://sem-py.github.io/re4-inventory/][b]Play the website version here[/b][/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZJWeUi0.gif[/img]

[i]An interactive, fully physicalized inventory management wallpaper based on the classic Resident Evil 4 attache case. Perfect for organizing your digital space or just scratching that inventory-sorting itch right on your desktop.[/i]

[h2]▲ FEATURES ▲[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Fully Interactive Grid:[/b] Drag, drop, and organize classic RE4 items including weapons, ammo, herbs, and first aid sprays.
[*][b]Tactile Audio:[/b] Sound effects taken directly from the original game when moving and rotating items.
[*][b]Atmospheric Background Music:[/b] Moody, immersive ambient track that can be toggled on or off.
[*][b]Minimalist Design:[/b] Clean, dark aesthetic optimized for desktop use without causing visual clutter.
[/list]

[h2]▲ CONTROLS ▲[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Left Click:[/b] Pick up / Place item. (Spacebar works in URL version).
[*][b]Rotate Held Item:[/b] Click the rotate button on the top-left of the grid (Or [b]R[/b] and [b]scroll wheel[/b] if you are using the URL version).
[*][b]Arrow Keys:[/b] Move held item. (URL version only!).
[*][b]ESC:[/b] Undo previous action. (URL version only!).
[/list]

[h2]▲ CREDITS ▲[/h2]
[list]
[*]Designed by [b]orbyt[/b].
[*]Original assets and audio properties belong to [b]Capcom[/b].
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
If you enjoy this project, please take a second to [b]Rate[/b] and [b]Favorite[/b]! Feedback and bug reports are always welcome in the comment section below.
